summary: Retest of the iteration_313 fixes for the PRC Refund Audit. All 6 fixes are verified and there are no regressions. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (test_prc_refund_audit.py, extended with new tests for fixes 1-5). test_refund_audit_manual.py prints ALL PASS. check_stuck_datetime.py PASS (stuck_checked goes 5 -> 6 when a datetime-typed created_at pending doc older than 24h is added). (1) With no auth, /api/recharge/admin/refund, /api/redeem/admin/bbps-requests, /bbps-request/{id}, /manual-refund and /api/bbps/admin/* all return 401, and the doc stays unrefunded. With an admin token, the list and detail return 200. (2) The refund_pending recharge row returns refund_state=eko_refund_pending and refund_state_prc=120 in both list and detail. The UI badge reads 'Eko Refund Pending · 120' with no Refund button. The modal refund-status-box says '120 PRC is held until the Eko refund (customer OTP) completes.' The refund_pending row does not appear in the audit items. (3) 5 concurrent POST /run gave [409,200,409,409,409]. A new run starts after the first one finishes, and the lock is released (run_id None). (4) Stuck query works for datetime created_at. (5) Receipt after a recharge admin refund shows total_prc_deducted=40 and prc_refund_amount=40. (6) Panel shows the 'Found not refunded' label, the service column reads 'Mobile Recharge', and audit-all-clear reads 'All failed transactions in the last scan are refunded. 1 need manual review.' when review=1. Regression: concurrent refund-one gives exactly one 200 and four 400; cron gives 401 without auth or with a wrong token, 200 accepted with the secret, and duplicate:true on a repeat.

issues: Grammar: '1 need manual review.' should be '1 needs manual review.' when count is 1 (RefundAuditPanel.js line ~129).
A card labelled 'null' (23) and a raw 'mobile_prepaid' label are shown; these need friendly labels or a fallback like 'Other'.

action_items: Optional: pluralize 'need/needs manual review' in audit-all-clear.
Optional: friendly label for null/mobile_prepaid service cards.
critical_code_review_comments: start_run lock: if the backend restarts during a run, the lock stays held for up to 2h (stale window) and admins get 409 until then. Consider a shorter stale window or a heartbeat on updated_at.
Stale-lock takeover marks the old run 'abandoned' but does not cancel its task. If a run really takes more than 2h, two runs can overlap. Refunds stay safe because of the refund_events guard.
seed_data_creation: TEST_RFAT_* (pytest, self-cleaning), TEST_UI-1..3 plus a refund_events claimed doc TEST_UI-5 for review>0 (seed_refund_audit_ui.py seed/cleanup). All cleaned up.

'Refund All Missing' uses window.confirm, so accept the dialog (import asyncio in the script).
